question: How many Blacklisted(address) logs did the USDC contract 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48 emit on Ethereum mainnet (chain 1) in the last 30 days (720 hours)? Count each log once and answer as a uint256.

definitions.window: The observation covers the last 720 hours ending at the latest finalized block available when requested. Resolve this once to inclusive fromBlock and toBlock; state reads use toBlock.
definitions.missing: If any required data is unavailable, inconsistent or incomplete, report inability; do not encode unknown as zero, false or an empty list.
definitions.metric: Count matching logs emitted by the token proxy only; deduplicate by blockHash, transactionHash and logIndex. Unit is logs. A complete empty log set returns 0.
